title: 真相深藏：通过潜在意图验证对抗语义伪装
summary: 该研究揭示LLM安全对齐的表面性，提出语义伪装攻击可绕过防护。通过分析SLM潜在激活轨迹，发现早期层保留有害特征，提出轻量级防御方法LIV，在PKU-SafeRLHF数据集上优于标准防护20-50%，无需重训练。
summary_en: This study reveals the superficiality of LLM safety alignment and proposes Semantic Camouflage attacks that bypass guardrails. By analyzing latent activation trajectories in SLMs, it identifies early-layer harm signatures and introduces Latent Intent Verification (LIV), a lightweight defense outperforming standard guardrails by 20-50% without retraining.
